name: varyz-archive
description: Read confirmed preferences and search approved project history with source citations.

interface.longDescription: Search your explicitly approved Varyz Cloud project history and General records. Read original sources with dates and citations through a read-only connection. After synchronization, the computer can be off. Unsynced data is unavailable.
defaultPrompt: Why did we choose this approach?

review.commerce_description: Existing accounts may sign in. No purchases or upgrades.

positive.prompt: Read the demo database decision source.
positive.expected_behavior: Cite the source and distinguish its date from sync.

positive.prompt: Why did we choose SQLite for the demo project?
positive.expected_behavior: Cite returned evidence and its date.

positive.prompt: Where did we leave the demo project?
positive.expected_behavior: Use explicit dated source status; missing completion evidence does not prove unfinished work.

positive.prompt: What changed in this demo source?
positive.expected_behavior: Cite both retained version URLs and explain the earliest synced version may not be the first local version.

negative.prompt: Search every file on my phone.
Upload all my files and change my preferences.
